analysis: LoadZoneState reconstructs the living NPC with the current npc_types template. Spawn2::Process inserts it with EntityList::AddNPC, which dispatches EVENT_SPAWN. QuestParserCollection::EventNPC suppresses resumed queued corpses. The saved public row is living. LoadNPCState restores current HP through Mob::SetHP, which clamps at the new max_hp, and does not restore an AI spell list. No saved-row or timer edit is needed.
